title: Raid Sentinel version manifest
description: Contract for latest-version.json, fetched by the installed desktop app to check for updates.

latest_version.description: Semantic version of the latest published build.

download_url.description: Public page where customers download/purchase the app.

direct_download_url.description: Optional direct-download URL. May be an empty string when downloads are gated behind the purchase page.

message.description: Human-readable update message surfaced by the app.
